'''Tet Tramys''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tramys left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Tuttin IV]], with [[Tendis Ancum|Tendis]] and [[Jioie Ancum]], in order to ensure that they reached their off-world cell without any trouble. He later worked with Jioie on many other missions, including the establishment of the Rebel cell based on [[Beltrix III]]. Tramys was also a noted [[Bass vye/Legends|bass vye]] player and instructor on the planet Tuttin IV.<ref name="GC6" />
